description: Vision helpers import Pillow but package install_requires omits it.
trigger: Install from package metadata without independently installed Pillow, then import exllamav3.util.vision.
expected_behavior: Package metadata supplies the dependency needed by the vision helper import.
actual_behavior: requirements.txt adds pillow, but setup.py install_requires omits it; the new top-level PIL import fails when Pillow is absent.

introductions.rationale: 224 adds the helper and requirements entry without adding the package metadata dependency.

verification.description: Reviewer compared dependency declarations and the top-level PIL import.
verification.limits: No installation, Pillow or NumPy execution. Reach limited to package-metadata installs lacking Pillow that import vision helpers.

affected_revisions.limits: Only the reviewed introducing revision is recorded; no continuous range or executed failure claimed.

cutoff_note: Post-hoc reviewer observation; administrative only, never teacher input.
